call_points.text: Q1 saw no new screen openings as fit-out-complete screens awaited regulatory licences.
No FCF target for FY27; priority is returning ROCE to pre-COVID levels.
Online ticketing penetration rose to ~69%, driving 29% YoY growth in convenience fee income.
Film hire cost fell ~200 bps YoY on movie mix and absence of a mega blockbuster; full-year film hire guided at 45-45.5%.
F&B COGS continued to decline YoY and is expected to be lower for the full year.
New web and app monetisation stream launched a month ago; annualised revenue seen at ₹2-3 Cr.
Advertising recovery may take another year to surpass pre-COVID levels; management expects big Q3/Q4 titles to drive ad flow.
Capital-light models now account for 55% of new screens, driving down capex intensity by 24% YoY.

timeline.summary: Shareholders approved via e-voting on April 25, 2026, Mr. Pavan Kumar Jain’s continuation as Non-Executive Director beyond age 75 with 95.17% votes in favor.
PVR INOX’s officials—MD Ajay Kumar Bijli, ED Sanjeev Kumar, CFO Gaurav Sharma—will host Q4 & FY2026 results conference call on May 11, 2026, at 4:00 PM (IST).
PVR INOX reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹67,426 Mn and a positive PAT of ₹3,868 Mn.
PVR INOX filed the transcript of its Q4 & FY26 earnings conference call held on May 11, 2026.
Ajay Kumar Bijli (Promoter) and Selena Bijli, Nayana Bijli, Niharika Bijli, Aamer Krishan Bijli (Promoter Group) declared no new encumbrances under SEBI’s takeover rules for FY2026.
ATC Logistical Solutions Private Limited (Promoter Group), represented by Ajay Kumar Kalra (Director), declared no encumbrances under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) for FY2026.
Sanjeev Kumar, Promoter of PVR INOX Limited, declared no encumbrance on shares during FY2026 ending March 31, 2026.
PVR INOX held its Q1FY27 earnings call on July 24, 2026, reporting 12% YoY revenue growth to ₹1,642 Cr, PAT of ₹71 Cr and a net cash position of ₹80 Cr.
PVR INOX’s officials, including Managing Director Ajay Bijli, Executive Director Sanjeev Kumar, and CFO Gaurav Sharma, will host a Q2FY27 results conference call on October 28, 2026, at 16:00 IST.
